summary: 10.0.35.03 Enterprise Release - Item Master & Stock Register UI/action desktop parity, RFC 4180 Bank Statement CSV import parser with Kotak metadata & SHA-256 fingerprinting, and Master Lookup system-generated code immutability
highlights: 1. Item Master UI & Functional Parity: Restored Desktop typography, title 'Items Master', subtitle, '+ New Item' primary button, entity toolbar (Search, Edit, Delete Item, Refresh, Import Excel, Export Excel) with complete selection-aware handlers, and full row context menu (+ Create Item, View Item, Edit Item, Audit Trail, Create Sale, Create Purchase, Delete Item).

2. Stock Register UI & Functional Parity: Restored 5 KPI cards matching Desktop Inventory.fxml, entity toolbar with live dynamic category loading, status indicators with colored dots ('In Stock' [green], 'Low Stock' [amber], 'Out of Stock' [red]), and aligned row actions (View Item, Edit Item, Adjust Stock, View History).
3. Item Master Modal ComboBoxes: Added dropdown selection for Default Discount % (0%, 2%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%) alongside GST %, Category, and Unit LOVs dynamically populated from master lookup service.

4. Bank Statement CSV Import (Kotak Parity): Fixed 'parseCsvLine is not defined' error by implementing an RFC 4180 character-by-character CSV parser. Ported KotakBankStatementCsvParser end-to-end including pre-header metadata extraction (Account No., Currency, Branch, Period), numeric row filtering, running opening/closing balance computation, and SHA-256 row & file fingerprints submitted to /api/bank-statements/imports.

5. Master Lookup Code Auto-Generation & Immutability: Locked 'Lookup Code' as read-only and immutable for non-role lookup categories. Populated next code directly from reference sequence (REF_LOOKUP). Removed slug overwriting from display value input so system-generated codes remain permanent.
